scenarios.title: binds entry correlation to the Act request, never an earlier Arrange request
steps: Given GET public-api /health (a real, earlier SUT request, not the flow under test)
Then the Arrange request itself succeeds
When POST /subscriptions for bob (the flow's real act request)
Then 201 with an active subscription for bob
Then (S3 gate): entry correlates to the Act request, and BOTH real requests are still present as effects
